هيئة الحكومة الرقمية

نص عربي يستخدم خط النظام المعتمد، باتجاه من اليمين إلى اليسار.

Latin text in the same family, so T1 sees one typeface for both scripts.

Western numerals only: 2026, 1280, 24. No mixed numeral systems.

Components

A card at radius 16 with shadow-xs

Body copy at the Text md step: 16 over 24, tracking 0.

Prose with an inline link inside a sentence, which WCAG 2.2 exempts from the target minimum, and which the auditor must exempt too.
